title: Eight specialty PET resins from Eastman receive RecyClass Approval
summary: Eastman copolyester resins earn RecyClass Approval, with six grades fully compatible with Europe's PET bottle recycling processes

extraction.key_fact: Eastman의 특수 PET 수지가 RecyClass 인증을 받아 유럽 PET 병 재활용 공정과 호환된다고 인정받았다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Eastman copolyester resins earn RecyClass Approval, with six grades fully compatible with Europe's PET bottle recycling processes
